maintainedSurfaces: VS Code Marketplace listing and installed-user homepage
public-facade release-kit assets and setup/support guidance
installed-user entry surfaces on README, public-source README/install, and public wiki home/install
refreshTriggers: SemVer tag or release-manifest contract change
Marketplace publication, listing identity, or homepage change
public release-kit asset or setup/support change tied to the exact released VSIX
installed-user entry-surface redesign or reader guidance change
release-procedure, ship-control, or docs-workbench publication contract change
strictSemverRule: after an exact release is published, the current published package line on main shall match that exact release line
when develop carries post-release work, the develop package line shall advance to the next exact release candidate before public-facing normalization continues
any later repo change intended for publication shall advance package.json and the top CHANGELOG.md heading to the next SemVer line before further normalization or publication
future sessions shall not treat an unreleased SemVer bump as complete until the matching public tag, public GitHub release, and VS Code Marketplace version are all published
future sessions shall not keep landing post-release changes on the previous exact release version number
future sessions shall not treat a burned exact release as the green release baseline for later publication
future sessions shall keep exact tagging blocked until npm run public:exact:pretag:proof passes cleanly against the promoted public facade and GitLab public_exact_pretag_proof retains the same proof

future sessions shall not treat an exact release as fully closed until the matching released main line has been back-merged into develop through the protected path and the resulting develop pipeline is green

future sessions shall not treat a candidate line as review-ready until the maintained public develop candidate head and maintained public wiki head are both published and retained in the authority candidate package

future sessions shall keep exact tagging blocked until the post-publication expert-agent review gate closes with no findings against the exact published public candidate heads retained in the authority candidate package
optional product-owner exploratory review may happen separately, but it shall not replace the clean expert-agent review gate for exact tagging

candidateStateModel.reviewReadyRule: local authority-green proof is necessary but not sufficient; review-ready opens only after the maintained public develop candidate head and maintained public wiki head are both live and retained in docs/product/public-release-candidate.{md,json}

expertAgentReviewSkill.gatingRule: exact tagging and Marketplace publication stay blocked until the latest retained expert-agent review against the exact published public develop candidate head and exact published public wiki head returns no findings

candidateStateModel.dirtyPublicSurfaceRule: preserve unrelated dirt, inspect overlapping files, patch only the maintained candidate slice narrowly, and pause only on direct unresolved conflicts instead of stopping publication merely because the worktree is dirty

major: breaks or removes a governed public or maintainer contract on purpose
changes a default branch, release topology, or install/runtime expectation in a way that invalidates an already-published workflow
drops support for a previously governed surface
minor: adds a new governed capability or supported workflow without breaking the current exact released line
adds a new maintained surface that future releases are expected to support
patch: fixes or hardens an existing workflow, release rule, procedure, branch policy, or CI posture without breaking the exact released contract
normalizes exact main back into develop before the next candidate line opens
captures governance-only or documentation-package hardening for an existing product line
semverDecisionFramework.decisionRecordingRule: record the chosen bump rationale in the control plane before further publication or release normalization continues

rationale: the remaining stale public-exact validation hardening now returns to short-lived feature/* branches from develop instead of reopening main for another exact hotfix attempt

authority exact v1.3.5 remains immutable while public GitHub exact v1.3.1 and VS Code Marketplace 1.3.0 still define the published surfaces, so any later exact reopen stays blocked until npm run public:exact:pretag:proof and GitLab public_exact_pretag_proof pass cleanly against the promoted public facade

rejectedAlternatives.hotfix: repeated exact reopen lines on main for brittle public-source validation repairs deviated from the governed GitFlow path, so the remaining hardening now stays retained on develop behind the fail-closed pre-tag proof gate
rejectedAlternatives.minor: the validation hardening still does not add a new governed capability or supported installed-user workflow
rejectedAlternatives.major: no exact public or maintainer contract is intentionally broken or removed; the retained v1.3.1 GitHub exact release stays intact while the gating fix advances on a feature lane

explicitNonTriggers: benchmark-only diagnosis that does not affect a shipped release surface
local characterization-only evidence changes without a governed release claim
unrelated docs or feature notes that do not affect install or release truth

acceptedCurrentContractBoundaries.characterization: linux-headless-recursive-load / labview-cli-connection-failed after one CloseLabVIEW recovery attempt

refreshTriggers: benchmark harness logic, packet derivation, or benchmark consumer tooling changes
comparison-report runtime execution changes that can affect HARNESS-VHS-002 truth
governed Windows benchmark image contract change
governed Linux runtime or benchmark-image contract change
a release or public claim would otherwise imply changed benchmark truth
explicitNonTriggers: UI-only or docs-only work that does not alter benchmark surfaces
public release-kit changes that do not alter benchmark contracts
out-of-scope alternative Windows x86 provisioning that is not part of the current governed image contract
reopenTriggers: the current governed Windows benchmark image contract gains same-bitness x86 provisioning
the governed NI Linux runtime or benchmark-image contract changes enough to justify a new full-window proof attempt
another in-scope benchmark provider becomes accepted authority truth

promotionRules: public GitHub default branch remains main so readers land on the latest exact released line by default
feature/* branches are cut from develop and merge back into develop
the governed branch-baseline assertion surface fails closed when develop does not yet contain exact main before a new candidate line opens
exact release closeout remains incomplete until the exact released main line has been back-merged into develop through the protected path and the resulting develop pipeline is green
release/* branches are cut from develop, merge into main, merge back into develop, and are deleted only after both merges complete
hotfix/* branches are cut from main, merge into main, merge back into develop, and are deleted only after both merges complete
exact SemVer tags are cut from main only after the protected main pipeline succeeds
local public-source promotion/check binds the intended checkout through --target-root or VIHS_PUBLIC_GITHUB_SOURCE_REPO_ROOT and fails closed when the target repo is dirty
candidate lines are not review-ready until the maintained public develop candidate head and maintained public wiki head are both published and retained in the authority candidate package
the active exact-tag gate uses the retained vi-history-suite-expert-agent-reviewer skill against the exact published public candidate heads and requires a no-findings verdict before tag eligibility
dirty public-source/wiki worktrees are controlled publication surfaces: preserve unrelated dirt, patch overlapping maintained files narrowly, and pause only on direct unresolved conflicts

hostDoctorSurface.failurePolicy: non-mutating-readback; combined surface may fail closed on drift when requested
non-mutating-readback; combined surface may fail closed on drift when requested

feature/*: focused tests for the changed surface
affected documentation or design gates before merge to develop
develop: npm run design:gate:assert-complete for governance or architecture work
release/*: public-facade proof before merge to main
hotfix/*: exact released-line package audit before merge to main
main: exact SemVer tags only after merged main is green

findingRequirementDiscipline: every governed finding is classified before slice closeout as requirements-update-required or no-requirement-impact
findings that change public workflow truth, release truth, branch policy, CI posture, runtime boundaries, or user/operator documentation behavior update SRS, RTM, and the test plan in the same slice
findings with no normative behavior impact retain an explicit no-impact rationale in the control plane instead of silently skipping requirement review
findingAdrDiscipline: every governed finding is classified before slice closeout as adr-update-required or no-adr-impact

findings that change architectural boundaries, public/private product surfaces, release topology, default-branch policy, runtime-provider strategy, required-check posture, or the public GitHub workflow responsibility matrix update an existing ADR or introduce a new ADR in the same slice
findings with no sustained decision impact retain an explicit no-impact rationale in the control plane instead of silently skipping ADR review

prohibitedBypasses: execution-policy bypass that skips canonical execution-request validation
execution-policy bypass that skips governed provider hard stops
PowerShell ExecutionPolicy Bypass on governed benchmark-image or host-proof helper surfaces
